title: Merge two coordinate vectors
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $x,y:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega$. Their merge along $J$ is the vector equal to $x$ on coordinates in $J$ and equal to $y$ on all other coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ and $y$ are vectors with entries in $\Omega$
